description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ChartsDashlet' which is a custom dashlet component for SuiteCRM. The class extends the 'Dashlet' base class and is responsible for managing the display and scripting of a chart dashlet based on saved report data. It includes methods for rendering the dashlet UI, generating associated JavaScript, and configuring dashlet options.

classes.name: ChartsDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for rendering chart reports within the SuiteCRM dashboard, supporting display, scripting, and configuration.
